arguments.title: Building the house shell
Cleaning the facade junctions
Folding roof and planting garden
Laying out rooms and stairs
Resolving details and opening glazing
Organizing the house model
Refining roof light and arrival
Framing the finished house
arguments.code: select(o=>o.name.includes('high clerestory'));moveInto('Upper floor');select('Ground floor');select('Upper floor','add');select('Folded roof','add');lookFrom({azimuth:-28,elevation:18,target:'selection'});

arguments.title: Labeling the concept floor plans
Viewing the upper floor plan
arguments.code: select(o=>o.name.startsWith('Upper Plan label'));moveInto('Upper floor');select(o=>o.name.startsWith('Ground Plan label'));moveInto('Ground floor');select(o=>['Folded roof','Ground floor','Connected garden','Site 20 x 30 m'].includes(o.name));hide();select(o=>o.name==='Upper floor');viewport('orthographic');lookFrom({azimuth:0,elevation:90,target:'selection'});

arguments.title: Viewing the ground floor plan
arguments.code: select(o=>o.name==='Upper floor');hide();select(o=>o.name==='Ground floor');show();lookFrom({azimuth:0,elevation:90,target:'selection'});

arguments.title: Restoring the full house
arguments.code: select(o=>['Upper floor','Folded roof','Connected garden','Site 20 x 30 m'].includes(o.name));show();select(o=>o.name.includes('Plan label'));hide();viewport('perspective');select(o=>['Ground floor','Upper floor','Folded roof'].includes(o.name));lookFrom({azimuth:-28,elevation:18,target:'selection'});

arguments.title: Viewing the upper floor plan
Viewing the ground floor plan
arguments.code: select(o=>o.name==='Ground Entry portal canopy'||o.name==='Ground Garden threshold canopy');hide();select(o=>o.name==='Upper floor');hide();select(o=>o.name==='Ground floor');show();lookFrom({azimuth:0,elevation:90,target:'selection'});

arguments.title: Restoring the full house
arguments.code: select(o=>o.name==='Ground Entry portal canopy'||o.name==='Ground Garden threshold canopy');show();select(o=>['Upper floor','Folded roof','Connected garden','Site 20 x 30 m'].includes(o.name));show();select(o=>o.name.includes('Plan label'));hide();viewport('perspective');select(o=>['Ground floor','Upper floor','Folded roof'].includes(o.name));lookFrom({azimuth:-28,elevation:18,target:'selection'});

arguments.title: Opening the covered garden threshold
Inspecting the garden connection
arguments.code: select(o=>['Ground Recessed garden slider','Ground Garden threshold return glass','Ground Garden threshold jamb'].includes(o.name));moveInto('Ground floor');select(o=>['Ground floor','Upper floor','Folded roof'].includes(o.name));lookFrom({azimuth:155,elevation:18,target:'selection'});

arguments.title: Capturing the upper floor
arguments.code: select(o=>['Folded roof','Ground floor','Connected garden','Site 20 x 30 m'].includes(o.name));hide();select(o=>o.name.startsWith('Upper Plan label'));show();select(o=>o.name==='Upper floor');viewport('orthographic');lookFrom({azimuth:0,elevation:90,target:'selection'});

arguments.title: Capturing the ground floor
arguments.code: select(o=>o.name==='Upper floor');hide();select(o=>o.name==='Ground floor');show();select(o=>o.name.startsWith('Ground Plan label'));show();select(o=>o.name==='Ground Entry portal canopy'||o.name==='Ground Garden threshold canopy');hide();select(o=>o.name==='Ground floor');lookFrom({azimuth:0,elevation:90,target:'selection'});

arguments.title: Capturing the site plan
arguments.code: select(o=>['Upper floor','Folded roof','Connected garden','Site 20 x 30 m','Ground Entry portal canopy','Ground Garden threshold canopy'].includes(o.name));show();select(o=>o.name.includes('Plan label'));hide();select(o=>o.name==='Site 20 x 30 m');lookFrom({azimuth:0,elevation:90,target:'selection'});

arguments.title: Presenting the finished house
arguments.code: viewport('perspective');select(o=>['Ground floor','Upper floor','Folded roof'].includes(o.name));lookFrom({azimuth:-28,elevation:18,target:'selection'});
